text_block_list.text: While talking with Matikanetannhauser during training—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look over there!
Look at that super cute stroller!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It has Umamusume ears on the roof,
and even a pink ribbon~!
choice_data_list: I wonder if she's an Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The ones standing next to the stroller
are Mom and Dad, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The mother doesn't have horse girl ears~.
Maybe she's a fan of someone?
choice_data_list: Maybe they're a fan of Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no way~. As if an ordinary
Umamusume like me could have fans――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh... ah!?
It happened in the blink of an eye. The father's backpack bumped against the stroller, sending it tumbling down the embankment――
(Patter patter...! Skrrrt!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: S-Safe!! I made it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh no, this is awful!

text_block_list.name: Father
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine!
More importantly, the baby...――wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...The baby was being carried by the mother, wasn't it? I didn't even notice...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aagh, she even went and did a full-body slide right into an empty stroller... Ugh.
choice_data_list: That run was completely free of hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Even if it was strong, it totally backfired, you know...? Her parents ended up apologizing and even thanking me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that cute baby stroller is safe,
of course, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... Why do I always end up
looking so uncool~?
Though Matikanetannhauser was visibly flustered, her parents' gratitude was genuinely heartfelt.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, of course it is~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If you spaced out, the stroller
might've rolled right away.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. But... ehehe.
I'm so glad it was just my imagination.
Though Matikanetannhauser gave an embarrassed chuckle, her actions had been truly admirable.
